nodes.q: What if I need an accountant who understands Canberra's property market and ACT/NSW tax rules?
nodes.a: The Canberra–Queanbeyan area spans two jurisdictions. In the ACT, land tax applies to residential properties that are not your principal place of residence — with no tax-free threshold, so it is charged from the first dollar of the average unimproved value. Queanbeyan properties fall under NSW rules, including NSW land tax and stamp duty. ACT payroll tax applied above a $2 million annual wages threshold in 2025–26; from 1 July 2026 the ACT Government lowered the threshold to $1.75 million (with a base rate of 6.75%). We match you with an accountant who understands both the ACT and NSW systems and how they apply to investment property, negative gearing changes and capital gains.

ACT payroll tax applied above a $2 million annual wages threshold in 2025–26; from 1 July 2026 the ACT Government lowered the threshold to $1.75 million (with a base rate of 6.75%). We match you with an accountant who understands both the ACT and NSW systems and how they apply to investment property, negative gearing changes and capital gains.

mobile.q: What if I need an accountant who understands Canberra's property market and ACT/NSW tax rules?
mobile.a: The Canberra–Queanbeyan area spans two jurisdictions. In the ACT, land tax applies to residential properties that are not your principal place of residence — with no tax-free threshold, so it is charged from the first dollar of the average unimproved value. Queanbeyan properties fall under NSW rules, including NSW land tax and stamp duty. ACT payroll tax applied above a $2 million annual wages threshold in 2025–26; from 1 July 2026 the ACT Government lowered the threshold to $1.75 million (with a base rate of 6.75%). We match you with an accountant who understands both the ACT and NSW systems and how they apply to investment property, negative gearing changes and capital gains.
